name: Enrow
summary: Find and verify professional emails and find phone numbers, asynchronously, by name, company or LinkedIn URL.

api_key.description: An Enrow API key (app.enrow.io > API settings). Sent in the x-api-key header.

notes: Every search is asynchronous: the POST returns an id at once, then poll the matching GET with ?id=.
Bulk endpoints (up to 5,000 searches for email and verification, 3,000 for phone) are not in this entry.
Credits are returned as credits_used on each POST response.

endpoints.name: Get account info
endpoints.summary: Credit balance and registered webhook URLs.

endpoints.name: Start an email search
endpoints.summary: Find a person's email from a name and company, or from a LinkedIn URL. Returns an id to poll.

fullname.description: Full name; required for name plus company searches.

company_domain.description: Company domain (this or company_name for name searches).

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL; used only when the request is not a complete name plus company search.

custom.description: Your own key-value data, returned in the result.

settings.description: {country_code, retrieve_gender}: country_code (default US) helps disambiguate company names; retrieve_gender returns gender.

notes: A read over POST: starts an asynchronous search, changes nothing.
Poll enrow.email.find_result with the returned id. Check qualification: found or not_found.

Name plus company search: 1 credit when an email is found, none otherwise (0.25 for accounts with an abnormally low success rate). LinkedIn URL search: 1 credit up front, settling to 1 if found, 0.25 if not found, 0 if Enrow fails.

endpoints.name: Get an email search result
endpoints.summary: Result of a search started with email.find.
notes: Reading a result never consumes credits.

endpoints.name: Start an email verification
endpoints.summary: Verify one address. Returns an id to poll.

custom.description: Your own key-value data, returned in the result.

notes: A read over POST: starts an asynchronous search, changes nothing.
Poll enrow.email.verify_result. 0.25 credit per verification. qualification is valid or invalid.

endpoints.name: Get a verification result
endpoints.summary: Result of a verification started with email.verify.
notes: Reading a result never consumes credits.

endpoints.name: Start a phone search
endpoints.summary: Find a phone number from a LinkedIn URL, or a name plus company. Returns an id to poll.

firstname.description: First name, with lastname and a company.

custom.description: Your own key-value data, returned in the result.

notes: A read over POST: starts an asynchronous search, changes nothing.
Poll enrow.phone.find_result. 40 credits per search by default (50 on legacy plans), refunded when no phone is found.

endpoints.name: Get a phone search result
endpoints.summary: Result of a search started with phone.find.
notes: Reading a result never consumes credits.
